sloka: एवम् एतत् पुरा वृत्तम् शस्त्र संयोग कारणम् ।अग्नि संयोगवत् हेतुः शस्त्र संयोग उच्यते ॥३-९-२३॥
transliteration: evam etat purā vṛttam śastra saṁyoga kāraṇam ।agni saṁyogavat hetuḥ śastra saṁyoga ucyate ॥3-9-23॥

translations.english: By association with the sword, he developed a violent attitude. And in that habitual state of excitement he was dragged into unrighteous ways which (ultimately) took him to hell.
